issuer: Ministerio de Inclusión, Seguridad Social y Migraciones
summary: The EX-18 is the official form to register in Spain’s Central Register of Foreigners as a resident EU, EEA or Swiss citizen; you receive a registration certificate that shows your NIE. You fill it in if you are an EU, EEA or Swiss citizen and will live in Spain for more than 3 months.
